packageRules.description: The toolchain pinned in mise.toml is what CI runs, so keep it current in one PR.
Action digests are pinned by SHA; group them so one PR covers the workflows.

The v2 plugin API is pre-stable and the TUI shares solid and opentui with the host, so these move together, are reviewed by hand, and never automerge. zod is pinned to the version @opencode/plugin uses.
